name: Lights in the Sky
source:
After a heist gone wrong, a pirate has been captured by the Chief of Police in a small idyllic tourist town. The pirate must escape the Chief's clutches and cross the rough, blizzard ridden waters of the sea.

An adventure story set in the early mid-century with a ton of sea-faring humor, heartfelt moments, and thrills.

[From [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/lights-in-the-sky]Itch.io[/url]]
